# Data processing of qPCR results
This notebook automates the parsing, column renaming, and 384-well quadrant mapping of raw qPCR expression data to quantify and compare cell-type-specific markers (Actb, Aldh1l1, and Gfap) across the Miltenyi and WorthGentle tissue isolation protocols.

```{r}
# Define folders
folders <- c("ws", "ws/04_validation_experiment", "results", "results/04_validation_experiment")

# Create folders if they don't exist
lapply(folders, function(f) if (!dir.exists(f)) dir.create(f, recursive = TRUE))
```

```{r}
# List of .csv files in folder
file_list <- list.files("data/validation_experiment", pattern = "\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)

# Create an empty list to store each dataset
qpcr_list <- list()

# Loop through each file
for (file in file_list) {
  lines <- readLines(file)
  data_start <- grep("^Well,Fluor", lines)

  if (length(data_start) == 0) next  # skip malformed files

  # Read the table from the correct line onward
  df <- read.csv(text = lines[data_start:length(lines)], stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

  # Create a safe name from the file name (remove extension and punctuation)
  name <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(file)) %>%
    make.names()

  # Store in list with that name
  qpcr_list[[name]] <- df
}

# View names of stored data
names(qpcr_list)

# Access one of the data frames, e.g.
head(qpcr_list[[1]])
```

# Rename columns
```{r}
for (file_name in names(qpcr_list)) {
  df <- qpcr_list[[file_name]]

  # Extract gene from filename (e.g., "admin_2025.07.08_Actb_123")
  gene <- str_extract(file_name, "(?<=_)[A-Za-z0-9]+(?=_[0-9]+$)")  # Extracts "Actb"

  # Skip if gene not found
  if (is.na(gene)) next

  # Define expected columns and generate new names
  original_cols <- c("Cq", "Melt.Temperature", "Peak.Height")
  new_names <- paste0(original_cols, "_", gene)

  # Rename only existing columns
  columns_to_rename <- original_cols[original_cols %in% names(df)]
  renamed <- setNames(columns_to_rename, paste0(columns_to_rename, "_", gene))  # new = old

  # Apply renaming
  df <- df %>% rename(!!!renamed)

  # Save back
  qpcr_list[[file_name]] <- df
}
rm(df, gene)
```


# Remove unwanted columns
```{r}
# Columns to remove
cols_to_remove <- c("Fluor", "Content", "Starting.Quantity..SQ.", "Target", "Peak.Height")

# Loop over all list items
for (file_name in names(qpcr_list)) {
  df <- qpcr_list[[file_name]]

  # Keep only columns that are NOT in cols_to_remove
  df <- df %>% dplyr::select(-any_of(cols_to_remove))

  qpcr_list[[file_name]] <- df
}
```

# Add suffixes columns
```{r}
library(tidyverse)

# Loop through each data frame in your list
for (file_name in names(qpcr_list)) {
  
  # 1. Detect the gene name from the file handle
  # We look for the gene keywords in the string
  current_gene <- case_when(
    str_detect(file_name, "Actb") ~ "Actb",
    str_detect(file_name, "Aldh1l1") ~ "Aldh1l1",
    str_detect(file_name, "Gfap") ~ "Gfap",
    TRUE ~ "Unknown"
  )
  
  # 2. Rename columns with the gene suffix
  # We include both space and dot versions just in case
  qpcr_list[[file_name]] <- qpcr_list[[file_name]] %>%
    rename_with(
      ~ paste0(.x, "_", current_gene), 
      .cols = any_of(c("Cq", "Melt.Temperature"))
    )
  
  message(paste("Applied suffix", current_gene, "to columns in:", file_name))
}

# --- Quick Check ---
# See the new names in the first file
colnames(qpcr_list[[1]])
```


```{r}
assign_384_quadrants_v5 <- function(df, filename) {
  
  # 1. Detection logic for missing Mouse 4
  # We use (?i) for case-insensitivity and check for the specific suffixes
  is_missing_m4 <- str_detect(filename, "(?i)gentle1|milt1")
  
  if(is_missing_m4) {
    message(paste("!!! Flagged as MISSING Mouse 4:", filename))
  } else {
    message(paste("Processing normal file:", filename))
  }
  
  df %>%
    mutate(
      # Extract Row (A-P) and Column (1-24)
      Row_Let = str_extract(Well, "^[A-P]"),
      Col_Num = as.numeric(str_extract(Well, "\\d+$")),
      
      # 2. Quadrant Logic
      # Rows: A-H (1:8), Rows: I-P (9:16)
      # Columns: 1-12, Columns: 13-24
      Sample_pub = case_when(
        Row_Let %in% LETTERS[1:8]  & Col_Num <= 12 ~ "Mouse_1",
        Row_Let %in% LETTERS[1:8]  & Col_Num > 12  ~ "Mouse_2",
        Row_Let %in% LETTERS[9:16] & Col_Num <= 12 ~ "Mouse_3",
        Row_Let %in% LETTERS[9:16] & Col_Num > 12  ~ if_else(is_missing_m4, "Empty", "Mouse_4"),
        TRUE ~ "Unknown"
      )
    ) %>%
    # Remove helper columns
    dplyr::select(-Row_Let, -Col_Num)
}

# --- Execution ---
# Use imap to ensure 'filename' is passed as the second argument (.y)
qpcr_list <- imap(qpcr_list, ~ assign_384_quadrants_v5(.x, .y))

# --- Verification ---
message("\nFinal check of sample distributions:")
map(qpcr_list, ~ table(.x$Sample_pub))
```

```{r}
# Helper: remove columns that repeat generically across files
clean_all_cols <- function(df) {
  df %>% dplyr:: select(-matches("^file$"))  # optionally drop 'file' column if duplicated
}

# Helper: merge multiple files by 'Well' and keep all columns
merge_all_columns_by_well <- function(file_names) {
  # Start with the first cleaned df
  merged <- clean_all_cols(qpcr_list[[file_names[1]]])
  
  for (fname in file_names[-1]) {
    df <- clean_all_cols(qpcr_list[[fname]])
    # Drop redundant columns before merging
    merged <- full_join(merged, df, by = "Well")
  }
  
  merged
}


# Split file names by suffix
files_gentle1 <- names(qpcr_list)[str_detect(names(qpcr_list), "_gentle1$")]
files_milt1 <- names(qpcr_list)[str_detect(names(qpcr_list), "_milt1$")]

files_gentle2 <- names(qpcr_list)[str_detect(names(qpcr_list), "_gentle2$")]
files_milt2 <- names(qpcr_list)[str_detect(names(qpcr_list), "_milt2$")]

# Merge
merged_gentle1 <- merge_all_columns_by_well(files_gentle1)
saveRDS(merged_gentle1, "ws/04_validation_experiment/merged_gentle1.rds")

merged_milt1 <- merge_all_columns_by_well(files_milt1)
saveRDS(merged_milt1, "ws/04_validation_experiment/merged_milt1.rds")

merged_gentle2 <- merge_all_columns_by_well(files_gentle2)
saveRDS(merged_gentle2, "ws/04_validation_experiment/merged_gentle2.rds")

merged_milt2 <- merge_all_columns_by_well(files_milt2)
saveRDS(merged_milt2, "ws/04_validation_experiment/merged_milt2.rds")
```

```{r}
# # Add Sample_clean to merged_gentle

   mutate(Sample_clean = if_else(Well %in% empty_wells,
```
